question: Barash is similar to the hindu festival Diwali, which is celebrated by which of following tribes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varli and Kokna**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Barash** is similar to the Hindu festival **Diwali**.
 
• It is celebrated by the **Varli and Kokna** tribes.
 
• These tribes are primarily found in the states of **Maharashtra and Gujarat**.
 
• The festival signifies the triumph of good over evil and is marked by various traditional rituals and festivities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Varli** and **Kokna** tribes have rich cultural heritages and unique traditions.
 
• Both tribes are known for their distinctive art forms, such as **Warli painting** by the Varli tribe.
 
• These tribes also celebrate other traditional festivals and have a deep connection with nature and their ancestral customs.
